answer_2.quote: We assess topic models based on topic quality and distinctiveness. Topic quality, reflecting interpretability and coherence, is measured using NPMI and CV, as they strongly correlate with human judgment. ... Topic diversity assesses the degree to which topics are distinct from each other. To evaluate this, we employ IRBO, as well as its word embedding-based extension, wI-C (Centroid).

answer_3.quote: LLM-based Topic Quality Assessment serves as a proxy for human interpretability, addressing the limitations of automated topic quality evaluations. ... In the rating task, an LLM scores topic coherence from 1 to 3 ('1' = not very related, '2' = moderately related, '3' = very related). In the intrusion detection task, an unrelated word is inserted among the top topic words, and the LLM must identify it. ... We used GPT-4 for these evaluations.
